title: Titanic: Shadows on the Sea
adaptation: Condensed fictional romance aboard the Titanic; original English captions and original soundtrack.

shots.title: Departure
shots.scene: A simple complete side silhouette of the Titanic, bow pointing right. Exactly four plain rectangular funnels, two slender masts with minimal rigging, and one row of small square windows. Two tiny lovers stand on the forward deck. Two broad plain wave strips at the bottom. Empty amber cloth above the ship.
shots.action: 0–5s: the leather waves slide slowly in opposite directions. 5–11s: the liner glides right, smoke curling as separate soft cutout shapes. 11–15s: two tiny human silhouettes on the forward deck turn toward each other. Fixed side-on camera.
shots.sound: Low waves, distant ship bell and a restrained reed theme over a warm drone.
shots.narration: Among a thousand journeys, two lives crossed.

shots.action: 0–6s: lower the lifeboat steadily on its two ropes while the flat deck tilts a few degrees. 6–11s: the lovers brace against the rail and clasp hands. 11–15s: the lifeboat meets the water and moves right; the couple remains on the ship. Keep all figures as articulated leather puppets.
shots.sound: Urgent dry drums, rope creaks, a ship bell, subdued straining metal and rising waves.
shots.narration: The boats descended. Their hands held fast.

shots.title: Hold on
shots.scene: The woman lies horizontally on top of a plain broad rectangular wreckage panel at right. The man is in the water at left with only his head and shoulders above two simple wave strips. Their hands meet over the small gap. No ship, deck, railing or iceberg. The same simple flat leather characters, quiet dim amber cloth.
shots.action: 0–5s: the man steadies the floating panel while the woman grips his hand. 5–10s: waves slide gently in front of his shoulders. 10–15s: their hands slowly separate and his silhouette sinks discreetly behind the front wave strip; she reaches toward the empty space. Quiet and non-graphic.
shots.sound: Percussion falls silent. Small waves, breath-like wind and a restrained low reed phrase.
shots.narration: He lifted her above the water. She held on to his memory.
